reviews.x: I had a wet brush I purchased from a salon that lasted me 4 years. I purchased this brush and within ONE WEEK the brush was falling apart. I purchased another wet brush from kohl’s and it has lasted me a month. I’m so dissatisfied with this brush purchase and the waste of money. Do yourself a favor and spend the extra $3 for the real deal and don’t purchase this brand off amazon. It’s bunk.

Junk and agree it is probably fake. Very light and flimsy plastic. I wish I had listened to the other reviews. DO NOT BUY THIS. I am returning and I am so mad that I have to go through this inconvenience for $8.00 but no way am I paying one penny for this piece of junk. I bought a hair brush for my dog for $2.99 and it’s better quality than this cheap plastic knock off. It’s a brush. Who can F-up a brush this badly?!? Whatever backyard outfit that is trying to pass this junk off as WetBrush shou

I should have known when I saw the price. I meant to take pictures before throwing it away, but it was garbage. It was so light and probably didn't weigh even half of my original that I purchased from a well-known beauty store. The material was cheap plastic and had scratches all over the back of it. The logo was half printed, half not. It wasn't even worth venturing out during this time to return the brush. It was a $3 lesson! Lesson learned!
A great product! I will never go back to using any other kind of brush after using a wet brush!

Really easy lightweight brush. First it took some getting used it because it was so lightweight compared to my old conair brush that’s been falling apart. I don’t have a lot of tangles and my hair is pretty straight but I liked the way this brush feels on my scalp than some of my store bought Revlon, conair etc brushes. Would purchase again.

reviews.t: All girl moms need one of these
reviews.x: This is a must have if your have a daughter. Or even if you have hair. I never thought that a brand of brush could make such a difference in my life! My kid finally has stopped crying every time I brush her hair. And using it on myself - it really is awesome. It doesn't pull and damage hair, it just magically brushes through anything!

I have been using this brush for the past 7 years and it's a game changer when you have curly/tangly hair and a sensitive scalp.  I finally got a new one after so long and it's just as great as the last one I had.
I absolutely LOVE these brushes!  I have very long, thick hair and there is no other brush on the market that detangles better!  The only brush I buy and now have all my family using them, also.

Omg. This brush is magic. This is the only thing that can get through my 2 year old's curly hair. Brushing her hair has always been a struggle. No matter how gentle and careful i am, she's always screaming and crying in pain when i try to brush it and i always ended up stopping before i was done. I heard about this brush and figured it was worth a try. First time using it, she was hesitant of course due to past experiences, but quickly settled down when she realized it wasnt hurting her at all.

I buy this brush for friends and family that have curly hair! I have found it to be the BEST brush on the market! It helps hold the curl, detangles and removes majority of frizz when used on wet/conditioned hair. My routine is to wash my hair daily but LEAVE the conditioner in my hair - then twist my hair up in a towel until I’m ready to put Suave mousse in, brush through and style. I have been using this brush for YEARS!! No need to buy an other brush cuz this is the only one you’ll need!!! (I

I bought this based on reviews and it’s great. It works perfect for my kids. Absolutely no hair pulling or ripping at all. I knocked one star off because it isn’t quite strong enough for my extremely thick rats nest hair. It doesn’t pull my hair but it does squish down when I’m going though the big knots. I think if I used it over time a lot it wouldn’t hold up. But for kids and people with normal hair this is the brush for you!

I ordered this brush at the suggestion of a friend. I get bad matts (sp?) in my hair from being bedbound. I can't spend a lot of time working on them bc I have nerve damage in my neck and brushing is painful. But this little brush makes short work of tangles and matts! I know it sounds lame to gush about a hair brush but i was frankly amazed, lol. Highly recommended.

This is either a manufacturing screw up or not a real wet brush. I've owned several and love them. I have thick, curly hair and wet brushes have always made brushing my hair a dream. This brush does not have that same silk quality,  all it does is rip my hair out. I thought I would save a few bucks and buy it online. My mistake.

reviews.t: Doesn't go through as easy ag my previous wet brush
reviews.x: I've bought a wet brush from Amazon before. It was great. This one, however does not go through my hair near as easy. I love the handle if it. It's silicone and doesn't slip and slide like the one i purchased at Walmart. The hair comes out somewhat easy, but the fuzz balls, not so much.

reviews.t: NO MORE PAIN BRUSHING SNARLY HAIR
reviews.x: Love Love Love! I’m guilty of only brushing my hair once a week and this brush powers thru the snarls and rat nests and it DOESN’T HURT. It’s a miracle. I like to use it when my hair is dry. I threw away my other hairbrush...that beast had been hurting me for years. NO MORE PAIN.

I love this brush!!! Brushing my girls hair was always such a struggle and alot of tears and yelling. I havnt had a single tear or "owie mommy" since we started using this. Absolutely fantastic!!!!!!!!! Literally saved my sanity and make one more thing so much easier in my life 😌

I heard great things about these but honestly don’t get the hype. They don’t seem to work any better than any other brush I’ve had. I have very course, curly hair and my daughter has thin but curly hair and it didn’t really do much for either of us. An ok brush overall.

reviews.t: So much nicer on tangles than a regular comb or brush
reviews.x: Much better for detangling than what we were using before. The bristles are very flexible which makes them less good for brushing hair back into a ponytail or anything like that, but for brushing out tangles after a bath or shower, this is our new favorite thing!

I have curly tangly hair and a friend of mine told me about this brush so I decided to try it. It is amazing! I was using a thick tooth comb which you would think would be the best solution for tangly hair but this brush is way better!

reviews.t: Super easy to brush, hardly any hair lost.
reviews.x: Glides right through natural curls, wet or dry.  I don't lose *nearly* the amount of hair I did with my old brush.  Well worth it!  Whether this one bites the dust or I lose it first, I'll replace it with the exact same.

If you have never had a Wet Brush Original Hair Brush get one! It is the best hair brush out there. I will never buy any other brand. It doesn't pull on your hair while you brush/detangle your hair. Simply the best.

reviews.t: The best brush for curly hair & tangles!
reviews.x: My favorite brush! My mom bought me one to encourage me to brush my hair a few years ago so I was due for a replacement. Wonderful as always. It doesn’t pull my hair and it doesn’t hurt when I DO run into tangles.

The Ones I've Had, Have Really Helped Me With Brushing Through My Super Thick Hair. The Bristles Are Very Gentle. They Don't Yank My Hair Out Like Other Brushes And It Doesn't End Up All Full Of Ripped Out Hair.

I have waist length thick hair. This brush is the only one I've found that gets through the tangles and isn't so painful. Wet or dry, it does the job. I have 4 of these brushes and I won't use any other brand.

reviews.t: A must have for curly  hair
reviews.x: I can't live without this brush. Makes washing my curly hair so much easier. No more trying for 10 minutes to get all the tangles out while trying to put conditioner in it. Great price. Great gift too!

claims.text: Many reviewers love this brush for detangling and say it works great on curly, thick, or snarly hair without pulling or causing pain.
Several reviewers believe the brush is fake or not a genuine Wet Brush, describing it as light, flimsy, and cheaply made.
Some reviewers report the brush falls apart quickly or rips hair out rather than detangling smoothly.
A few reviewers find it works well for kids and causes no hair pulling or ripping.
One reviewer notes it doesn't glide through hair as easily as a previous Wet Brush and struggles with fuzz balls.
